research_lineage: Defined after S97 exposed short-squeeze and horizon-instability risk. S98 is a separate, contaminated-development strategy and cannot be used to rehabilitate S97.
hypothesis: An asset's own long-term trend is a better eligibility gate than applying BTC's regime to every coin. Combining absolute momentum, relative ranking, volatility scaling and cash should retain upside trends without unlimited short-squeeze risk.

data.source: checksum-verified public Binance USD-M monthly archives

signal.decision: Monday 00:00 UTC using only candles with close_time strictly before the decision
signal.absolute_gate: asset close above its own 200-day simple moving average and its 84-day return above zero
signal.relative_rank: 84-day return divided by 42-day daily volatility times sqrt(84)
signal.funding_veto: skip a long when mean realized funding over the prior 28 days exceeds +0.0001 per settlement
signal.selection: hold up to the three highest ranked eligible assets; emit an explicit all-cash target when none qualify

execution.end_of_study: liquidate at final close with scenario costs

robustness.leave_one_symbol_out: rerun stress after excluding each asset
robustness.uncertainty_diagnostic: 5000 deterministic circular 28-day block bootstraps of full-period stress daily returns
robustness.continuous_ledger: run once through all three diagnostic slices without resets

historical_gate.full_stress: net PnL > 0, Sharpe >= 0.50, max drawdown <= 15%, positive-month share >= 45%
historical_gate.time_dispersion: all three stress slices non-negative and at least two strictly positive; largest positive month <= 60% of total positive monthly PnL
historical_gate.parameter_robustness: both 63d and 126d momentum neighbors have positive full stress PnL
historical_gate.timing_robustness: Wednesday and Friday rebalance phases have positive full stress PnL
historical_gate.symbol_robustness: at least five of six leave-one-symbol-out stress replays are profitable
historical_gate.promotion: historical pass means paper-forward challenger only for at least 26 decisions and 180 days; live remains disabled

disclosures: S98 was designed after inspecting S97 and earlier Book A results; no historical interval is true OOS.
Daily bars use the same-day close as a funding mark proxy and do not model intraday liquidation, exchange outages, latency or taxes.
No post-result parameter adjustment is permitted for S98.
